reason: A plugin marketplace for browsing, searching, assessing, installing, enabling, disabling, and uninstalling DeepSeek Harness plugins, with lifecycle management and restart support.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页浏览和搜索插件目录，并管理插件的安装、启用、停用与卸载。
summaries.en: Browse and search a DeepSeek Harness plugin catalog while managing plugin installation, activation, deactivation, and removal.

capabilities: Browses and searches a remote plugin catalog
Calls a remote AI search service when enabled
Downloads and installs plugins from repository sources
Enables, disables, and uninstalls installed plugins
Writes plugin configuration and manages backups or rollback
Requests or performs host application restarts
